alkylation_reagent.evidence: A volume corresponding to 15 µg of protein from each sample was taken up in 100 µL 1× SP3 Lysis Buffer (final concentrations: 5% (wt/vol) SDS; 10 mM TCEP; 200 μL 40 mM Chloracetamide; 200 mM HEPES pH 8) and heated for 5 min at 90°C.

cleavage_agent.evidence: After the final wash & collect step, the beads were taken up in 25 mM Ammoniumbicarbonate (ABC) containing 1 µg Trypsin (Protein:Trypsin ratio 30:1).

collision_energy.evidence: Collision induced dissociation (CID) energy was set to 35% for the generation of MS2 spectra.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS/MS experiments were performed on an Orbitrap Elite instrument (Thermo, Waltham, MA, USA) that was coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatography (LC) system (Thermo).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: The analytical column was encased by a column oven (Sonation) and attached to a nanospray flex ion source (Thermo).

labeling.evidence: Label-free quantification and match-between-runs was activated.
